twbNotes.2026-07-05|OREE|Perrier Florian: Left handed, stable bh but surprisingly unreliable fh, won all my shots on his fh. He struggled with deep center high balls. Week service. Bad volley when backspin. I played very well 1st set, had as always a relaxing period in the 2nd , was 3-3. Playing consciously worked, no overdoing it. Had a plan of next 2 shots almost all the time, worked very well. When I started to make mistakes, moving the feet more worked. When doubts and mistakes, the plan and feet saved me
twbNotes.2026-07-09|OREE|DELHAYE Vincent: Controlled 1set, he started better 2nd, I was too passive, many mistakes, all went down. When I had a plan for the first 2 shots in the first game, all good, the last 2 sets I forgot many times this. 1st service failed me many times. He played high on my bh strategy and worked. Too many mistakes when I was not playing simple with a cross strategy. Many volleys missed badly when I build the point nicely. Bh ok but I need to be more attentive, lower, shoulders turn, stay sideways. Bottom line, I need to be more disciplined with the strategy long term.
twbNotes.2026-07-12|DAVIS|BETTENS Frédéric: Much better level, left handed, very good slice, lots of effects in his serve, many drop shots , no idea how to play with him
twbNotes.2026-07-13|DAVIS|De Pauw Selwyn: Started very well, 4-0. Good service, attacking, deep balls with spin, attacked short balls. He started to play better, less errors, I made some errors, quickly 4-2 and 4-3. My service was gone, couldn't server anymore, only pushing the ball, my fh followed. He made 5-4 for him. The only thing I could do is to think again about short term plan for each service and return (next 2 balls), breathing, watching the ball and moving the feet. Somehow I won the set 7-5. Probably was a combination of him doing errors and me thinking every time about the next 2 balls.
twbNotes.2026-07-16|DAVIS|SERVONNAT Guillaume: Impressed too much by his level, good on both sides, complete overall. Average serve either with effect. Good drop shot, came to net. He struggled a bit with deep middle shots. I was successful only when building my points and attacked from inside court on his backhand, or attacked with spin on his forehand. What little worked for me was when I hit with a bit of punch. The revelation for me was how well worked when I stayed low and advanced when hitting. My backhand was better today because I hit it with more punch and let go. Another revelation was the volley when I watched him when coming to the net and timing my split step when he hits. My service was fine when I tried to have more punch. Things to remember: a bit more punch on my shots including the service, stay low and advance when hitting, timing the split step with him hitting the ball.
